text: True or False: Satellite QKD outperforms long-haul fiber over 1,200 km because free space above the atmosphere suffers only diffraction (a polynomial loss) rather than the exponential absorption of fiber.
explanation: True — fiber loses roughly 240 dB over 1,200 km exponentially, while free space above the atmosphere suffers only diffraction (a ~30 cm telescope beam spreads to a few meters), tens of dB, a ~10^20 advantage that the Micius satellite exploited for kHz-rate keys. This change in the loss law is why satellites exist.
